scope: Twelve fixed origin-only pilot scopes; annotation and ascertainment feasibility, not a representative registry outcome cohort or locked clinical test

phases.purpose: Append origin-only planned outcomes, detailed scope, design, references and bounded alias candidate discovery without changing origin membership
phases.query_approval: Freeze generated query bytes, explicit projection, schema gaps, aliases, original twelve IDs, code and source identities before dispatch
phases.origin_enrichment: A new child seal; no overwrite or reinterpretation of prior freezes

phases.purpose: Find same-trial follow-up and exact-alias candidate trials; adjudicate leads without equating a match to a program transition
phases.selection: Retain all twelve origin members. Freeze source-only aliases before future records. Match intervention names and secondary names of drug/biological interventions, any phase, without event-date/status/outcome filtering
phases.overflow: Retain failure and coverage gap; no truncation, outcome ranking or automatic relaxation
phases.results_phase: Freeze selected candidate IDs and explicit result-table projection before any result extraction; keep planned and reported endpoints separately versioned

temporal_policy.source_date_precision: DATE is a civil day with unknown conventional offset [-12,+14]; preserve [D00UTC-14h,(D+1)00UTC+12h)
temporal_policy.version_eligibility: Qualify current version with last_update_posted_date, never initial registration or first result date alone
temporal_policy.boundary_versions: Hold March31/April1 at April1 midnight; hold December31/January1 at January1 midnight; recover an eligible older version or keep unknown
temporal_policy.event_dates: Preserve original month/year/day precision and ACTUAL versus estimated. Whole occurrence interval must fit (origin,horizon]; an imputed AACT date cannot refine precision
temporal_policy.raw_quarantine: Later raw rows may be retained evaluator-only for coverage; they cannot support eligible labels or historical predictors

review.procedure: Two fresh source-grounded agent assessments, blinded to each other, then separate reconciliation; reviewers may use eligible original primary sources under fixed time/scope limits
review.unit: Each of twelve origin scopes by each of three endpoint IDs, plus every discovered candidate event
review.source_search: NCT ID and frozen product aliases; official registry, sponsor/investigator primary reports and primary publications. Maximum five retained primary-source documents per origin scope; inaccessible/missing documents explicit. Stop at bound, never expand because results are favorable
review.current_web: Discovery only unless document version/publication and relevant content independently qualify by ascertainment. Current API record payloads cannot be backdated with initial posting dates
review.prespecified_information: Origin protocol/SAP primary efficacy objective, analysis population, comparison, decision rule and multiplicity must qualify for clinical success/failure; reported nominal significance alone is insufficient
review.risk: Origin scope and prior qualifying event must be explicitly adjudicated. Discovery readiness is insufficient; unresolved global prior risk remains a label hold
review.scope: Assess formulation, experimental/background/comparator/rescue role, dose/route/schedule, partners, age/line/biomarker/condition; source numeric IDs are local to each snapshot
review.null_rule: Unknown, censoring and competing events have null binary values. No record, no results, business stop, completion or enrollment cannot automatically become clinical failure
review.independence: Distinct review contexts do not certify external scientific truth or independent model errors
review.membership: No origin removal for difficult scope, missing evidence, source corrections or unavailable outcomes

power_precision.inputs: Only endpoint-qualified labels and explicit dependence graph; raw candidates and source counts remain separate
power_precision.simulation: Reuse independently checked paired-statistic/null-calibrated primitives in a new adapter only if two qualified units per class exist; preserve explicit score-correlation and label-error assumptions
power_precision.insufficient_classes: No simulation or AUROC estimate; report nonestimable with qualified and unresolved counts, not zero power
power_precision.calibration: Separate held-out calibration precision; no Brier/calibration estimate without valid probability predictions and mature labels
power_precision.pilot_limit: Twelve purposively selected scopes do not establish registry prevalence, effective independent sample size or the full-cohort power target

execution.network: Local PostgreSQL only during extraction; public primary-source research separately recorded
execution.transactions: Read only; generated SQL and exact source/code hashes frozen before dispatch
execution.integrity: Two identical reads, child/FK checks, requested-member/missingness accounting, pre/post source pins, exclusive cluster lease, durable journal and stopped-server/closed-port checks
execution.outputs: Fresh ignored evaluator directories; retain failures; no automatic retry
execution.isolation: No label or future ancestor may enter agent-visible manifests or historical features

next_stage: Retain qualified labels and feasibility decision or an explicit no-fit/no-powered-comparison disposition; scientific qualification is separate from completing the audit work
